name: sdlc-kit
description: Opinionated, project-agnostic Claude Code kit for a full software development lifecycle: specs, planning, TDD implementation, review, verification, shipping, and issue-tracker integration.

plugins.name: sdlc
plugins.description: Full SDLC workflow for Claude Code: agents, skills and slash commands covering spec -> plan -> implement -> review -> verify -> ship, plus ADRs, security review, debugging and releases.

plugins.name: tracker
plugins.description: Issue-tracker integration for the SDLC workflow. Ships a zero-dependency local file tracker that works today, and a Jira adapter (REST or Atlassian MCP) behind the same command surface.
